name: dive-computer
description: Native BLE bridge to the locally vendored libdivecomputer for scanning, connecting to, and downloading dive logs from Shearwater dive computers. iOS: Swift package under ios/. Android: Kotlin + JNI sources living in the app project (android/app/src/main/{cpp,java/com/erebus/diveapp/divecomputer}). Both register the same NativeModules.DiveComputer surface typed in src/index.ts
